name: Moilian Dead
tactics: The Moilian dead takes no actions until a living creature comes within 5 squares, at which point it uses stirrings of unlife to rise up and charge the nearest enemy. It tries to stay close to its enemies lest Orcus’s curse reasserts itself.

alignment.name: Chaotic Evil
alignment.description:
Chaotic evil creatures have a complete disregard for others. They kill, steal, and betray others to gain power. Their word is meaningless and their actions destructive. Their worldviews can be so warped that they destroy anything and anyone that doesn’t directly contribute to their interests.
	By the standards of good and lawful good people, chaotic evil is as abhorrent as evil, perhaps even more so. Chaotic evil monsters such as demons and orcs are at least as much of a threat to civilization and general well-being as evil monsters are. An evil creature and a chaotic evil creature are both opposed to good, but they don’t have much respect for each other either and rarely cooperate toward common goals.
	For the purpose of game effects, a chaotic evil creature is also considered evil.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Frost
traits.details: living creatures that start their turns within the aura take 5 cold damage and grant the Moilian dead combat advantage until the start of their next turns.

auras.name: Frost
auras.details: living creatures that start their turns within the aura take 5 cold damage and grant the Moilian dead combat advantage until the start of their next turns.

powers.name: Stirrings of Unlife
powers.trigger: when a living creature moves to within 5 squares of the Moilian dead

hit.description: necrotic damage. If Moilian dead is currently prone, as a free action it stands and makes a charge attack against the nearest enemy

effect.description: The Moilian dead falls prone and gains a +4 bonus to AC and all defenses until the start of its next turn or until it makes an attack.
A Moilian dead’s slam attacks deal 2d6 extra cold and necrotic damage to targets it has combat advantage against.
